limitations.note: The patch correctly changed the counter wrap threshold from 4 to 5, but it also gated valid_b with valid_a and tied ready_a high, changing the original behavior during stalls, reset, and the first clock after reset.

The test asserted the rewrite’s assumptions—ready_a always high and valid_b asserted only when the sixth bit arrived—so its passing result did not verify that the original reset and stall behavior was preserved.
